_comment: Release attestations. Copy to release-attestation.json (git-ignored) and fill in for a real release. Each item must be explicitly attested with WHO and WHEN — never auto-filled. These are human/operational confirmations the release gate cannot verify by itself. They do NOT bypass the LIVE safety blockers (functional SMS provider only when SMS is enabled; approved risk matrix) — those are checked against the running system and cannot be waived.
_release_comment: Traceability binding: the exact commits and run/drill references this release covers. The gate echoes these (it does not verify a CI/attestation service). Fill client_sha/server_sha with full commit SHAs and the run refs with GitHub Actions run URLs / the restore-drill reference.
